issues.claim: audit_md body is at most 300 words (house rule)
issues.problem: Counted independently: the body (headings excluded, closing 'Prepared from...' line included) is 301 words; 320 if the headings are counted. It is at, or a hair over, the limit rather than comfortably inside it.
issues.fix: Trim 5-10 words (e.g. shorten the Snapshots bullet to 'a services page and four service pages' and drop 'None of it is reachable now.'), then recount before sending.

issues.claim: audit_md: 'The profile and phone number still work, so calling is the practical route.'
issues.problem: The profile loading is verifiable and true, but 'the phone number still works' cannot be verified without calling, which we are not permitted to do. It is a sensible assumption (the live profile shows (973) 905-2129 and opening hours), not a sourced fact.
issues.fix: Reword to what was actually seen, e.g. 'The profile still loads and shows the phone number and opening hours, so calling is the practical route.' Same for the internal severity_reason 'working phone number'.

issues.problem: The audit text says the desktop and phone-width screenshots of the identical error were captured at the www host, and the www entry does list both files, so the evidence exists - but the primary 'listed on Google' domain entry records no screenshot of its own while audit_md treats the desktop/phone images as the evidence for 'advancehomereno.com'.
issues.fix: Point domains[0].screenshot_files at the same two files (they show www.advancehomereno.com, which is the address the Google link resolves to), or state in domains[0].result that the screenshots are recorded under the www entry.
